audit_verify_api.limitation: Detects alteration or removal of entries inside the chain, and removal of the newest entries: the latest hash, the entry count and the latest id are stored as an anchor authenticated with the storage key. Someone who can write the database file AND read the storage key can rebuild the chain and the anchor without trace. Someone who can write the database file can also restore an older copy of the whole database together with its older anchor (rollback); that is not detected. An anchor held outside this machine is not implemented.
